scientific_integrity: Analytic arguments establish degree classification and sharp coefficient. A standalone finite numerical checker is consistency evidence, not independent validation.
scientific_limitations: Coupling interpolation and star geometry are fixed. Momentum-optimized leakage is only for alpha=0 near t=1; other vertex couplings, graphs, or alpha optimization are not covered. Priority beyond the checked primary sources is unconfirmed.
title: Degree-four cutoff for perfect cyclic scattering and sharp near-rotational leakage in quantum stars
